objectTypes.doc: A conversation: line, choice, branch, action and end nodes joined by edges; conditions read facts and state.

fields.name: speaker
fields.doc: Default speaker name of the graph's lines.

fields.name: speakerEntityId
fields.doc: Default speaker entity, by authoring id (optional).

fields.name: npcGraphRef
fields.doc: Legacy (P1.3/P1.4) string reference, read only while the typed field is empty; authoring.migrateRefs moves it into the typed field and clears it.

fields.name: entry
fields.doc: Entry node index.

fields.name: nodes
fields.doc: The nodes; an edge names them by index.

fields.name: edges
fields.doc: The edges.

objectTypes.doc: An entity definition: the prefab a placed entity presents, its defaults, variants and overridable fields.

fields.name: prefab
fields.doc: The view prefab instantiated for every placed entity.

fields.name: defaultScaleMilli
fields.doc: Uniform scale in thousandths.

fields.name: startsVisible
fields.doc: Whether a placed entity starts visible.

fields.name: startsAlive
fields.doc: Whether a placed entity starts alive (spawned).

fields.name: variants
fields.doc: Variants 1..n; variant 0 is the definition itself.

fields.name: overridableFields
fields.doc: Fields a placed entity may override: scaleMilli, visible, alive, tint.

fields.name: animatorBindings
fields.doc: Animator integer parameters driven from entity slots.

fields.name: interactionKind
fields.doc: Interaction kind exposed to interaction systems (empty = not interactable).

fields.name: materialTextures
fields.doc: Texture bindings for renderer material slots; presentation content, not recipe structure.

objectTypes.doc: Conditions over facts, items, quests, regions and time, combined with all or any.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: All conditions must hold, or any one.

fields.name: conditions
fields.doc: The conditions, in evaluation order.

objectTypes.doc: Lists the narrative definitions (facts, graphs, quests, items, rules...) of one world; the bake writes its content manifest.

fields.name: world
fields.doc: The world this content belongs to.

fields.name: definitions
fields.doc: Every narrative definition of the world (any type providing the narrative.definition capability).

objectTypes.doc: A named int32 world fact (narrative.fact.<name>), set by dialogue, rules and quests and read by conditions.

fields.name: factName
fields.doc: Fact name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores (the slot is narrative.fact.<name>).

fields.name: initialValue
fields.doc: Value before anything sets it.

fields.name: persistent
fields.doc: False = the fact returns to its initial value when a conversation ends (a conversation-local flag).

objectTypes.doc: A runtime UI Toolkit document: UXML, style sheets, draw layer, the screen it belongs to and its binding map.

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: The screen (ui.screen value) the document is shown on; Hud documents also show under modal screens.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Draw order; larger is drawn above.

fields.name: uxml
fields.doc: The document's UXML (its element layout).

fields.name: styles
fields.doc: Extra style sheets of this document.

fields.name: bindings
fields.doc: Binding map: element -> property <- source (vm:/slot:/event:/command:).

tools.doc: Studio tier Agent: requests a generated voice clip for a line through the media generation gateway (the paired Editor session supplies the provider).
Sets the condition of a branch node, or the availability condition of one option of a choice node.

args.name: option
args.doc: Option index of a choice node (-1 = the node itself, a branch).

tools.doc: Creates (or updates) a fact on a content set: name, initial value and whether it persists past a conversation.

args.name: persistent
args.doc: False = reset when a conversation ends.

args.name: authoringId
args.doc: Optional canonical GUID for a newly created fact; later candidate refs use this authoringId. Existing facts cannot be re-identified.

tools.doc: Replaces a condition set with one typed fact comparison. The fact AuthoringRef can name an earlier candidate output once the engine resolves dependency-ordered references; link this condition with dialogue.linkCondition.

args.name: fact
args.doc: Fact AuthoringRef, including the output of an earlier dialogue.setFact operation.

tools.doc: Binds an imported Texture2D to a renderer material slot on every view of this definition. Omit texture to clear the binding. Changes content stamp, not recipe revision; rebuild views to apply.

args.name: texture
args.doc: Imported texture AuthoringRef; omit to clear.

args.name: renderer
args.doc: Renderer index in prefab depth-first order, including inactive children.

args.name: property
args.doc: Shader Texture2D property, for example _BaseMap or _MainTex.

tools.doc: Binds an element property (text, value, visible, enabled, selected, items) of a UI document to a vm:, slot: or event: source.

args.name: element
args.doc: Element name in the document's UXML.

args.name: source
args.doc: vm:<model>.<Property> (hud.QuestStageTitle = first active quest stage title; hud.ObjectiveText = first unfinished objective) | slot:<owner>/<domain>.<member>@<target> | event:<name>.

args.name: property
args.doc: text | value | visible | enabled | selected | items.

args.name: format
args.doc: Format: a {0} pattern or percent:<max>; for items, command:<prefix>.
